description: Ammonia refrigeration of coolers, freezer warehouse, seafood room, and trailers; temperature monitoring and alerting for cold storage CCPs
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Product temperature abuse begins within hours and forces holds or disposal of up to $1.8M of inventory; cold storage is a CCP (9 CFR 417.2(c)(4)); refrigerated seafood is a botulism-risk product under seafood HACCP
manual_workaround: Refrigeration runs on its local controller if SCADA is lost; hourly manual thermometer log by warehouse staff; move product to trailers on shore power
dependent_third_parties: Refrigeration contractor; cold-chain monitoring vendor; utility; generator fuel supplier
dependent_people_or_facilities: Refrigeration technicians; warehouse staff; engine room; coolers

description: Smokehouse cook cycles and chilling for bacon, smoked sausage, hams, deli meats, and smoked fish
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Product in a cycle when control is lost must be held and evaluated (9 CFR 417.3(b)); about $590K revenue per production day; lethality and stabilization records are required for release
manual_workaround: Smokehouse controllers run stored cycles locally; chart recorders on two smokehouses; manual probe readings every 30 minutes

description: Recipe release, automated brine and cure (sodium nitrite) dosing to Lines 2 and 4, CIP of brine systems
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Cured and injected products cannot be made without verified formulations; a wrong nitrite level is a chemical hazard; recipe data changes rarely so the last approved release is the recovery point
manual_workaround: Hand-weighed cure batches from printed, FSQA-signed formulation sheets with second-person check

business_process: Processing, packaging, lot coding, and labeling (Lines 1-3)
description: Grinding, stuffing, slicing, packaging, metal detection, checkweighing, lot codes and labels
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Lines stop without MES label and lot-code data; mislabeling risks misbranding recalls (9 CFR 418); about $590K revenue per production day across all lines
manual_workaround: Pre-printed label stock with manual lot codes and second-person check; metal detectors run standalone

description: Brining, smoking, dip mixing, packaging of FDA-regulated seafood
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $44K revenue per production day; seafood HACCP and food defense records required (21 CFR 123.9; 21 CFR 121.140); fish supply is perishable
manual_workaround: Pause intake; hold raw fish under refrigeration up to one day; manual brine salt checks

business_process: Food safety records and pre-shipment review
description: Electronic HACCP, seafood HACCP, and food defense records; pre-shipment record review; records for FSIS and FDA review
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Product may not ship until records show critical limits were met (9 CFR 417.5(c)); records must be available for official review (417.5(f); 21 CFR 121.320)
manual_workaround: Paper CCP forms and paper pre-shipment review; hold finished product

description: Order release, picking, trailer loading, bills of lading
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Grocery chain delivery windows; missed deliveries lead to chargebacks and lost shelf space
manual_workaround: Paper pick lists from the daily order export; handwritten bills of lading

description: Lot tracing forward and back; recall execution under 9 CFR 418.3
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: FSIS notification within 24 hours if adulterated product entered commerce (9 CFR 418.2); during an active recall the MTD drops to 4 hours
manual_workaround: Daily traceability export to a controlled offline copy (planned); paper shipping records
dependent_third_parties: Cloud provider; ERP and WMS vendors

business_process: Receiving of carcasses, primals, fish, and ingredients
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Perishable inbound loads must be checked and refrigerated on arrival; suppliers can hold loads for about a day
manual_workaround: Paper receiving log and handheld thermometers

business_process: Finance, payroll, outlet store, and online store
description: Accounts payable and receivable, payroll, outlet sales, online orders
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Weekly payroll for 250 employees; outlet and online sales are about 3% of revenue
manual_workaround: Repeat prior payroll through the payroll vendor; outlet uses its cellular card terminal
